findings.observation: The source records _identity(material.get_script()) and _identity(native.next_pass), then validates fresh getter reads rather than those recorded identities.
findings.consequence: If native state changes between those reads, a completed receipt can include an already-observed unsupported non-null script or next_pass identity while the later getter used by the guard returns null. Repeating this pattern in both passes can leave equal receipts with unsupported captured facts.
findings.requested_change: Validate the same captured identity or local native reference used to construct it. Preserve the observed identity on refusal. Avoid adding extra getter reads.
findings.evidence_kind: static branch/data-flow analysis; native interleaving has not been executed or established
findings.scope_limit: This correction cannot establish atomicity. Concurrent changes between independent reads remain an explicit later admission limitation.

preliminary_non_findings: Fresh private C247 composition preserves one registry close and does not accept caller-made receipts.
